summary: The default AWX-style execution environment example builds awx.awx with pytz from the collection's requirements.txt; use the image in ansible-runner by setting container_image, process_isolation_executable and process_isolation in env/settings.
questions: How do I use a custom execution environment with ansible-runner?
What goes in ansible-runner env/settings for containers?
Where is the awx-ee default image defined?

answer_card.title: Use an EE image with ansible-runner
answer_card.answer_md:
In the private data directory, `env/settings`:

```
---
container_image: image-name
process_isolation_executable: podman # or docker
process_isolation: true
```
